description: Shared definitions for the Impact Indexer review system.

subjectRef.description: Reference to the subject being reviewed.

cid.description: Optional CID for record subjects to pin to a specific version.

uri.description: The subject identifier. For records: AT-URI (at://did/collection/rkey). For users: DID (did:plc:xxx). For PDSes: hostname (example.com). For lexicons: NSID (app.bsky.feed.post).

subjectType.description: The type of subject being reviewed.
